name: Hibiscus - Balance 1g PLUS Vape Device — BREEZE Canna
description:
Experience the pinnacle of cannabis innovation with Hibiscus, an energizing Balance blend that combines juicy berries and bright citrus with delicate floral notes and subtle herbal undertones. 

This sophisticated formulation features a full spectrum of cannabanoids, including 20% CBD, and enhanced with 3% THCV, a rare minor cannabinoid known for its potential to regulate appetite and boost metabolism. 

Crafted with beta pinene, terpineol, and limonene, this premium blend delivers an invigorating and uplifting experience that energizes both body and mind.
